name: 表示切替付きパスワード欄
prompt:
Use reference 1, the assigned Japanese mock, as the exact canvas and layout authority. Recreate only its compact password-field component. Preserve its very wide 390:114 aspect ratio (3.421:1); do not turn it into a 16:9 image, add vertical padding, or center a small component in a taller canvas. Keep the relative positions from the mock: canvas top and bottom margins are each about 24px; the 「パスワード」 label begins at x=24,y=24; the outlined input begins at x=24,y=46, is 342px wide and 44px high, and ends at y=90. Match the mock's Japanese text, field dimensions, spacing, and eight generic mask dots exactly. The entire output frame should have the mock's short 114px height relative to its 390px width.

Use reference 2, the analysis-only crop from the original screenshot, only for the shape and construction of the label/input and outlined eye. It does not override the mock's Japanese text, eight-dot masked state, geometry, or canvas. The original source remains preserved and its catalog selected bounds remain null.

Use a flat white #FFFFFF background, no texture, shadow, glow, mint tint or green wash. Use Meiryo Regular 12px/16px for the label in #6E6E6E; one white field with a 1px #D9DDDA border and 6px radius; eight evenly spaced generic mask dots in #1D1D1D; a crisp 20x16px outlined eye with pupil in slate #526173. Show the masked default state without a slash. Keep all edges, text, dots and icon aligned and clean.

Output only this one password field component. Omit the Dropbox logo/header, email, Back link, password recovery link, remember checkbox, login button, footer, keyboard, caret and all surrounding page content. No extra controls or copy. The eye is a static visual affordance only and does not claim working toggle behavior. Do not add margins beyond the assigned mock.
reviewNotes: Best of two authorized raw ImageGen attempts. Japanese mock text and eight masked dots retained; eye is static. Visible residual: output is 2172x724 (3:1), about 14% taller than the 390x114 mock ratio at equal width, and the field appears vertically short after width normalization. Mark needs-correction; no post-processing, native edits, owner approval, or behavior claim.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
